profile.headline: Selara AI
profile.summary:
I'm interested in projects that better people's lives, meaningful human interactions, good design, workflow and product improvement, and delivering new technology to the public at large. Good ideas keep me up at night.

Pictured above is my beloved 1946 Aeronca Chief 11AC. Let's go for a ride!

positions.title: Senior Engineer, Map & Spatial
positions.description:
On the Map & Spatial team, I served as a core engineer on ForeFlight's geographical information system (GIS) web mapping platform, building and publishing aviation and weather maps across ForeFlight's web ecosystem

I designed data pipelines for high-performance delivery of our maps. I integrated Jeppesen's famous aeronautical charting datasets into our vector maps, and this allowed pilots to feel right at home with their Jeppesen navigation charts, whether in the cockpit of an old taildragger, or forward deployed in a C-130 Hercules.

I developed advanced spatial tooling, including real-time geospatial visualization pipelines. This often involved tweaking 3D textures and shaders in WebGL and WebGPU, or tweaking CDN cache policies, or putting out production fires via SSH, and documenting it all along the way.

I also ran an internship program on behalf of ForeFlight for Bowdoin College computer science students in Brunswick, Maine. I taught web GIS fundamentals, advanced geospatial visualization techniques, and a whole lotta keyboard shortcuts. They are our future!
positions.insights: Skills: iOS Development · TypeScript · WebGL · Svelte

positions.title: Senior Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed and built the company's first large-scale data ingestion, indexing, and search platform, processing hundreds of thousands of unstructured documents (PDF and Word) into a normalized, queryable system
- Implemented full-text indexing and advanced query capabilities using Elasticsearch, enabling non-technical users to explore complex datasets through a web-based interface
- Developed a single-page web application that allowed stakeholders to construct sophisticated search and filtering workflows without requiring knowledge of the underlying data model
- Architected an automated document generation system, transforming structured data into standards-compliant PDFs used at scale by thousands of end users
- Led development of the company's first external data integration and syndication pipeline, enabling bidirectional data exchange with third-party platforms and significantly increasing system reach and adoption
- Worked closely with product, design, and business stakeholders to translate ambiguous requirements into scalable technical solutions with clear user value
- Supported ongoing system evolution by improving performance, reliability, and data quality across the platform

positions.title: Engineering Manager
positions.description:
- As 2nd hire at the company and primary engineer, I worked to build the software platform from 11k users in 2015 to greater than 300k by the end of 2018, generating $2.8M in annual revenue
- Transformed the dated page-refreshing MVP software platform in 2015 to the highly performant single-page application it is today using React and an all new JSON API
- Created an open-source JavaScript library, ReactiveRecord, a Redux-based state container with more than 2,300 downloads in 2018
- Gained notoriety for myself and Avail after giving a talk about JavaScript and Ruby-on-Rails at React Chicago in 2018, hosted at SpotHero offices

positions.title: Journalism Instructor
positions.description:
I supervised a team of 30 to construct a three-acre field training exercise for use by the school, providing a realistic field training environment for students.

I mentored one instructor to successfully complete the four-month-long instructor certification process.

I redesigned and updated the school’s social media classes to reflect current industry practices.

I increased the school’s overall social media engagement by 60% by creating and implementing a multi-platform social media plan

I wrote a computer program that automates student grades for field training exercises, saving fellow instructors several hours of work per class iteration.

positions.title: Marketing & Public Affairs Representative
positions.description:
I sold billboard advertisements to 11 vendors throughout the Dallas-Fort Worth metropolitan area in the beginning of the summer months, generating an estimated $270,000-worth of free advertising.

I allocated $11,000 in advertising funds during a 5-month time frame, and earned the RS more than $24,000 in free advertising through the sale of public service announcements.

positions.title: Public Affairs Specialist
positions.description:
I successfully designed and launched a physical print publication (Roundup Magazine) from the ground-up. This included refining an editorial team, and creating a printing and distribution system to support a 64,000 sq. mile circulation each month. This publication is still in circulation today.

I authored and published a 120-page cross-platform social media usage guide for district recruiters that is still in use today.

I earned the Navy Achievement Medal for completely redesigning the 8th Marine Corps District public website. This included writing more than 5,000 lines of code, implementing a content management system for news, editorial content and press releases, and implementing social media capabilities for the site.

positions.title: Public Affairs Specialist
positions.locationName: Marine Corps Air Station Iwakuni, Japan
positions.description:
I publicized the 31st Marine Expeditionary Unit throughout several training exercise deployments in multiple countries throughout the Far East, including in Exercise Forest Light in Nihonbare, Japan, exercise Cope Tiger in Khorat, Thailand, Exercise Foal Eagle in Yecheon, South Korea, and Exercise Ulchi-Focus Lens in Pohang, South Korea.

I successfully designed and launched a physical print publication (The Iwakuni Approach) from the ground up. This included creating an editorial team, and creating a printing and distribution system to support a 20,000-copy circulation each week. This publication is still in circulation today.

I earned a United States Marine Corps Combat Correspondents Association Merit Award for Publication Design in 2008 for my work with “The Iwakuni Approach.”

My position as editor of "The Iwakuni Approach" was held as I was a lance corporal (pay grade E-3), though the position is traditionally held by a staff sergeant (pay grade E-6).

educations.fieldOfStudy: pilotage, aeronautical science, unmanned aircraft systems
